description: This file defines a ResumeRepository class that provides CRUD operations for managing resumes in a database, including methods to create a new resume record, retrieve a resume by ID, and list resumes associated with a specific user.

classes.name: ResumeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling CRUD operations related to resumes, inheriting from BaseRepository.

methods.name: int create( self, user_id: UUID, file_name: str, content_type: str, content_text: Optional[str] = None, storage_path: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new resume record in the database with provided user ID, filename, content type, optional content text, and storage path. Returns the ID of the inserted resume.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get(self, resume_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a resume record by its ID, returning it as a dictionary if found.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_user(self, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all resumes associated with a specific user ID, ordered by creation date descending.

ctags.pattern: /^    async def get(self, resume_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:$/
